name: Hip and thigh
note: Schematic right hip and thigh, not to scale: fan-shaped gluteal muscles as outlines, the others as bellies with tendons. Positions follow standard anatomy atlases (e.g. Gray's Anatomy, 1918, public domain); shapes are simplified for teaching.

rectus-femoris.name: Rectus femoris
rectus-femoris.action: Straightens the knee and bends the hip (crosses both)

vastus-medialis.name: Vastus medialis
vastus-medialis.action: Straightens the knee (the vastus intermedius lies underneath)

sartorius.name: Sartorius
sartorius.action: Bends hip and knee, turns the thigh out

tfl.name: Tensor fasciae latae
tfl.action: Abducts and bends the hip; tightens the IT band

gracilis.name: Gracilis
gracilis.action: Brings the thigh in; bends the knee

adductor-magnus.name: Adductor magnus
adductor-magnus.action: Brings the thigh in; its rear part extends the hip

biceps-femoris.name: Biceps femoris
biceps-femoris.action: Bends the knee, extends the hip (outer hamstring)

semitendinosus.name: Semitendinosus
semitendinosus.action: Bends the knee, extends the hip (inner hamstring)

semimembranosus.name: Semimembranosus
semimembranosus.action: Bends the knee, extends the hip (inner hamstring, underneath)

gluteus-maximus.name: Gluteus maximus
gluteus-maximus.action: Extends the hip; turns the thigh out

gluteus-medius.name: Gluteus medius
gluteus-medius.action: Abducts the hip; holds the pelvis level on one leg

gluteus-minimus.name: Gluteus minimus
gluteus-minimus.action: Abducts the hip, under the gluteus medius
